alter PROCEDURE DW.SP_CI_DEMOGRAPHICS_COR
AS
BEGIN

WITH DimAccount AS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.DimAccount 
    WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP', 'LNS', 'CCD', 'TRU', 'TRY')
)
,DimCustomer AS (
    SELECT TOP 10000 * FROM DW.DimCustomer
    WHERE CurrentIndicator = '1' AND  CustomerType = 'Corporate' 
)

SELECT 
DDC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
,DDC.CustomerName AS CustomerName
,CASE WHEN DDC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DDC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DDC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DDC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
,DDC.CustomerType AS CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth AS Birthdate
,DDC.MaritalStatus AS MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender AS Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
,DDC.Email AS EmailAddress
,DDC.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
,DDC.City AS City
,DDC.Province AS Province
,DDC.ZipCode AS ZipCode
,DDC.Country AS Country
,DDC.SMEClassification AS SMEClassification
,DDC.LineOfActivity AS LineOfActivity
,DDC.IndustryDescription AS IndustryDescription
,DDC.Subsector AS Subsector
,DDC.SubsectorDescription AS SubsectorDescription
,MIN(DA.AccountOpenedDate) AS Tenure
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceFull) AS TotalRelationshipBalanceFULL
,SUM(DFRB.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated) AS TotalRelationshipBalancePRORATED
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull) AS TotalMTDADBPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFMTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated) AS TotalMTDADBPHPDepositsPRORATED
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull) AS TotalYTDADBPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFYTD.AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated) AS TotalYTDADBPHPDepositsPRORATED
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountFull) AS TotalOutBalPHPDepositsFULL
,SUM(DFDB.BalanceAmountProrated) AS TotalOutBalPHPDepositPRORATED
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceFull) AS TotalOutBalPHPLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLB.OutstandingBalanceProrated) AS TotalOutBalPHPLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountFull) AS TotalCreditLimitLoansFULL
,SUM(DFLL.CreditLimitAmountProrated) AS TotalCreditLimitLoansPRORATED
,SUM(DFCE.RelationshipExposure) AS TotalOutBalPHPCards
,SUM(DFCB.StatementBalance) AS TotalOutstandingBalanceCards
,SUM(DFCL.CurrentCreditLimit) AS TotalCreditLimitCards
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_CardsFULL
,SUM(DFTE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated) AS TotalRelationshipExposureLoans_CardsPRORATED
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueFull) AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSECFULL
,SUM(DFP.PortfolioEndValueProrated) AS TotalSecuritiesPortfolioSizeCBSECPRORATED
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountFull) AS TotalFundValueTrustFULL
,SUM(DFF.AUMAmountProrated) AS TotalFundValueTrustPRORATED
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentFull) AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRYFULL
,SUM(DFI.OutstandingInvestmentProrated) AS TotalOutstandingInvestmentTRYPRORATED
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
,DDC.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName AS RiskRatingType
,DDR.RiskRatingName AS RiskRating
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator AS Suspended Indicator
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS MBKEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator AS RIB_BOBEnrollmentIndicator
,CASE WHEN DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,DDC.GenerationalCohortSK AS GenerationalCohort
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName AS MarketSegment
,DDC.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
FROM 
DimCustomer DDC
JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount DDCA ON DDC.CustomerSK = DDCA.CustomerSK
JOIN DimAccount DA ON DDCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDB ON DDB.BANKSK = DDC.BANKSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BusinessDateSK,CustomerSK,TotalRelationshipBalanceFull,TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated,SourceSystemCode,ProratedMarketSegmentSK FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance) DFRB ON DDC.CustomerSK = DFRB.CustomerSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDFull,AverageDailBalanceAmountMTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD) DFMTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFMTD.AccountSK  
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull,AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDProrated FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD) DFYTD ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFYTD.AccountSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,BalanceAmountFull,BalanceAmountProrated FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance) DFDB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFDB.AccountSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,TotalRelationshipExposureFull,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure) DFLE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,OutstandingBalanceFull,OutstandingBalanceProrated FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance) DFLB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLB.AccountSK    
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,CreditLimitAmountFull,CreditLimitAmountProrated FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) DFLL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFLL.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,RelationshipExposure FROM DW.FactCardsRelationshipExposure) DFCE ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,StatementBalance FROM DW.FactCardsOutstandingBalance) DFCB ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCB.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,CurrentCreditLimit FROM DW.FactCardsCreditLimit) DFCL ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFCL.AccountSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,TotalRelationshipExposureFull,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure) DFTE ON DDC.CustomerSK = DFTE.CustomerSK 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,PortfolioEndValueFull,PortfolioEndValueProrated FROM DW.FactSecurityPortfolio) DFP ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,AUMAmountFull,AUMAmountProrated FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue) DFF ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFF.AccountSK  --remaingin
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,OutstandingInvestmentFull,OutstandingInvestmentProrated FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment) DFI ON DDCA.AccountSK = DFI.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingSK FROM DW.DimCustomerRiskRating) DDCRR ON  DDC.CustomerSK = DDCRR.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingTypeSK,RiskRatingTypeName FROM DW.DimRiskRatingType) DDT ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDCRR.RiskRatingTypeSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDT.RiskRatingTypeSK)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT RiskRatingSK,RiskRatingName FROM DW.DimRiskRating) DDR ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDCRR.RiskRatingSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDR.RiskRatingSK)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT MarketSegmentSK,MarketSegmentName,MarketSegmentID  FROM DW.DimMarketSegment) DDMS ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,DFRB.ProratedMarketSegmentSK) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DDMS.MarketSegmentSK)
WHERE (DA.PayrollIndicator = 'Y' OR DDMS.MarketSegmentID IN ('MA', 'UA', 'VIP')) AND DDB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')


GROUP BY 
 DDC.CustomerId
,DDC.CustomerName
,DDC.CustomerType
,DDC.DateOfBirth
,DDC.MaritalStatus
,DDC.Gender
,DDC.MobileNumber
,DDC.Email
,DDC.AddressLine1
,DDC.AddressLine2
,DDC.City
,DDC.Province
,DDC.ZipCode
,DDC.Country
,DDC.SMEClassification
,DDC.LineOfActivity
,DDC.IndustryDescription
,DDC.Subsector
,DDC.SubsectorDescription
,DDC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
,DDC.GenerationalCohortSK
,DDT.RiskRatingTypeName
,DDR.RiskRatingName
,DDMS.MarketSegmentName
--,DDP.PartyID
,DDC.Occupation
,DA.PayrollIndicator
--,DDR.DimRiskRatingName
--,DDT.DimRiskRatingTypeName
,DDC.LastKYCDate
,DDC.DataPrivacyConsent
--,DDCA.SuspendedIndicator
,DDC.ValidStartDate
,DFRB.BusinessDateSK
,DDC.GlobalCIF
,DDC.SourceSystemCode

END
